name: mycrew
description: A harness for Claude Code: primitives and house rules, specialists who carry the work through the build pipeline, a product plane with its task board, and the leadership that steers them. Install mycrew-tools first.

plugins.name: mycrew-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/4 — small, project-agnostic skills you reach for mid-work, plus the house rule files the rest of mycrew builds on.

plugins.name: mycrew-specialists
plugins.description: Layer 2/4 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who runs the build pipeline as coder-* skills and writes the code, and a designer with taste who works against the real CSS frontend. Each keeps its own domain data; the designer's catalog holds design systems to draw inspiration from, never to copy.

plugins.name: mycrew-product
plugins.description: Layer 3/4 — the product plane and its task board, both kept on backlog.md: what the whole product must do, and what is being done about it right now. /product-init stands it up.

plugins.name: mycrew-management
plugins.description: Layer 4/4 — the leadership of the product: a chief who is the human's deputy over the whole product, and a lead who holds one feature, each spawning specialists to carry the work. Management only: it never writes code.
